info.title: McpIt: expose ASP.NET Core APIs as MCP tools
info.description: Offline token-cost analyzer for any MCP server. Reads a live server or a saved tools/list JSON, reports estimated per-tool and total tokens your tool definitions cost the model, and fails a CI build over a --budget. Part of McpIt.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: mcp-token-report - offline MCP tools/list token-cost analyzer

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Render the report as Markdown instead of plain text.

options.name: --budget
options.description:
Fail (exit 1) when the total token cost exceeds N tokens.
Token counts are an OFFLINE heuristic estimate (no network for tokenizing, ~±20%).
